text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Osaka Hai, Maruzensky
devoted herself to training harder than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... J-Just a quick rest.
I definitely overdid the pace.
choice_data_list: You're trying so hard, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's not like I'm being overly stoic
or anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose it feels like you're having so much fun you can't contain it.
That's just how thrilling that match against Rudolf was!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So no need to worry, it's totally A-OK-V!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Speaking of worries, though,
there's something that's been bugging me a bit~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the other end of Maruzensky's gaze as she speaks is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One more rep...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: M-Me too...!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "The Yasuda Kinen is coming up soon, so I get that those girls are working hard, but..."
choice_data_list: Looks like they're getting desperate over there too.
Looks like they're getting desperate over there too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if anything happens,
big sis here will be right by your side to support you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after that.
After finishing my work, I was heading back to my room when—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Maruzen-san's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: G-Grass-chan is... Grass-chan is in big trouble!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Sensei, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm okay.
Looks like I just twisted it a little.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... I'm so glad
it wasn't a serious injury~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, truly...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much
for calling the nurse for me!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I apologize for causing you concern.
choice_data_list: Looks like I pushed myself too hard.
Looks like I overdid it a little.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Um, we need to get
much faster.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Watching the race between Maruzen-san and the President
right before my eyes... it was truly incredible...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "...It drove home the harsh reality that we have yet to catch up."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It turns out their desperation was caused by a sense of urgency.
choice_data_list: It's dangerous if you push yourself too far, you know?
It's dangerous if you push yourself too far, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I am well aware of that, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder and Special Week wore expressions
that said, "We cannot stop now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like something vital
is missing from them right now."
choice_data_list: Could you hold on a sec?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
M-Maruzensky-san...!?
Did you really come all the way here from home?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun contacted me!
So, how bad is the injury?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan messaged me!
So, how bad is your injury!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I explained the extent of the injury and the circumstances leading up to it to Maruzensky, who had rushed over.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see, I see~... So that's why you got so impatient.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy to see you working so hard too.
It really fires me up to have a rival to push each other with.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Even so, it feels like there is something missing from the two of you right now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What I'm missing...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll teach you,
so keep big sis company for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Maruzensky-san.
Just what is this 'missing piece'...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Watching my race with Rudolf made you all realize
that things couldn't stay the way they were, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Was there anything else you noticed?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Anyone else... meaning who, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Racing against Rudolf was the absolute most fun~!
Both of us giving it our all, completely lost in the moment...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It was so fun that we didn't want it to end—and we understood that without having to say a single word.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That feeling of having "fun"
always gives me a push from behind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because it's fun, you want to run faster.
Because it's fun, you want to win races... you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Still, right now, you're all so impatient that you've forgotten to actually have fun."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So I'm sure that even if we raced right now,
I would win. Absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Do you two remember how your eyes would sparkle every time you watched me run?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "And so, she kept running happily every day, saying 'I'll catch up to you~'...."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You must have it inside you—
the feeling that running is fun.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's true that lately, I've just been pushing myself nonstop, thinking I have to run more and work harder...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan! Once your leg gets better,
let's time each other again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And just like before, let's be happy that we got a tiny bit faster today!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Enjoyment pushes you forward.
Truly, 'what one likes, one does well.'

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Instead of feeling impatient about desperately chasing them down, I run imagining the joy and thrill of when I finally catch up—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thinking about it really does make you feel like running, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Ehehe, I can't wait for training!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What a relief~
I'm glad I could be useful as a big sister figure!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thank you for reaching out to me too, Trainer-kun!
choice_data_list: Because they're both chasing after you.
Because both of them are chasing after you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for reaching out to me too, Trainer-chan!"
choice_data_list: Because they're both chasing after you.
Because both of them are chasing after you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I have to keep doing my best
as a dependable big sister!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: By the way, Maruzen-san, why did you bring us all the way out here?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that obvious?!
When you think of youth, the riverbank is the classic spot, right?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now that you're feeling better, let's yell together!
You stupid sun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then I'll do it too...
Hey sun, you big jerk!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um... The sun has already set, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the juniors successfully got back into shape and began running toward the Yasuda Kinen.
